description: This PHP source file defines the DataGroupDao class, which provides data access methods for DataGroup and DataGroupPermission entities within the OrangeHRM system, including retrieval of data groups, permissions, and API permissions based on roles and filters.

classes.name: DataGroupDao
classes.description: Data access object for DataGroup and DataGroupPermission entities, providing methods to retrieve data groups, permissions, and API permissions based on roles and filters.

methods.name: getDataGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a DataGroup entity by its name.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Retrieves DataGroupPermission entities for specified data groups, user role ID, and self permission flag.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves DataGroupPermission entities associated with a specific API class name and roles.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves DataGroupPermission entities based on filter parameters, including roles and API data group inclusion.

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all DataGroup entities ordered by description.
